BluePearl Pet Hospital North Dallas serving NE Texas and beyond.
We are located in Lewisville near the intersection of I-35E Express and the Sam Rayburn Tollway. Our clients come from all over the Dallas/Ft. Worth metroplex area, the state of Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Louisiana.
Our reviews.
Our services.
BluePearl North Dallas is here to provide compassionate care for pets. We offer emergency services for pets with urgent care needs, as well as specialty care appointments available by referral. Please call before you come to ensure availability.
Our high-tech equipment and treatment regimens are similar to those found in human hospitals. We work closely with your pet’s primary care veterinarian to ensure that your pet’s medical history is considered when forming a treatment plan. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians, and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital North Dallas.
We are a compassionate team of board-certified veterinary specialists, emergency and specialty clinicians, highly trained veterinary technicians, assistants, and client service representatives all dedicated to helping pets in need of advanced medical care.
Our specialized and experienced team provides comprehensive care through advanced medicine and surgery. We are devoted to promoting the quality of life in pets and empowering and educating our clients and community.

Testimonials.
“My Yorkie Jax was attack by another dog and broke his neck, we were referred to BluePearl due to the need of a neurologist. We were so scared. Upon arrival, the front desk was so kind and rushed us to a room. Mandy the nurse came in and cried with us and comforted us and and listen to our story, she made it easy to leave him there because she related to us. Mandy and the staff showed so much compassion and love. They never seemed bothered by us always coming to visit our dog.
The next morning I got a picture of Jax standing and walking. Mandy went out of her way to send us the picture just to give us peace of mind and to show us he’s doing great.
Dr. Marzullo, Dr. Black, and the other doctors there are amazing. Words will never be able to express the gratitude we have for BluePearl and the amazing staff they have, and the great leadership behind this team. I have never in my dog owning years seen a nurse and a dog neurologist get on the floor and cry with a patient, and they did. If I had to rate them on a scale of 1-10, they would get 100.
If you are ever in need of a great veterinarian, BluePearl in Lewisville, TX is the place to be.
Again, our words will never be able to describe our gratitude for all that the staff did to help our little buddy recover and get better and to love on us as well in the process. We will always keep them in our prayers and I hope this reaches many people. The love and kindness is priceless and that’s what they give at a very affordable price.”
–Angela F.
